name: Evercraft EarthWorks Autonomy
intents: reduce truck queue time at the excavator
retrofit autonomy without replacing the whole fleet
coordinate loaders haul trucks and dozers
AI dispatch for quarry haul trucks
should we automate this material loop
plan a controlled autonomous heavy equipment pilot
authority: public software proof, read-only site screening and simulation/shadow pilot design
boundaries: current public proof is software and a hardware-neutral control contract
no claim of unsupervised production autonomy on full-size equipment
physical control requires an approved adapter, controlled operating domain, independent stop/takeover and separate safety case
site screening is not a safety certification

commercial.purpose: Model one repetitive material flow, establish baseline evidence, simulate the operation, expose bottlenecks and identify the smallest justified autonomy or dispatch pilot.
